rationale: Multiple policy and execution failures are evident. The agent appears to have executed order-changing writes without explicit customer confirmation. It updated the shipping address on the wrong order (#W8268610) even though the user requested the address change for #W2702727. It also seems to have initiated a cancellation on #W2702727 without confirming it was the older order and without first confirming with the user, despite the conditional instruction about guaranteeing processing within 5 days. The agent did not clearly authenticate the user before acting, did not explain the status differences between the two orders, and did not provide the requested totals (refund total and order total after the address change). It also stated a successful update without tool-supported, correctly targeted action. These issues violate the pass criteria.
